## Collection templates

- Body parts: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/part/{slug} and https://materia.significanthobbies.com/part/{slug}.md (24 entries)
- Conditions: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/condition/{slug} and https://materia.significanthobbies.com/condition/{slug}.md (77 entries)
- Remedies: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/remedy/{slug} and https://materia.significanthobbies.com/remedy/{slug}.md (207 entries)
- Compounds: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/compound/{slug} and https://materia.significanthobbies.com/compound/{slug}.md (60 entries)
- Studies: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/study/{slug} and https://materia.significanthobbies.com/study/{slug}.md (175 entries)
